description:
Project Overview: An interactive, software-based astronaut health monitoring dashboard designed for space missions.
What It Does:
 * Real-Time Telemetry: Streams simulated vital signs (heart rate, blood pressure, sleep, stress) and spaceflight risks (radiation, fluid shifts).
 * Interactive Visuals: Features a clickable human body interface to inspect specific organ systems and health trends.
 * Smart Alerts: Uses color-coded status badges (Green/Yellow/Red) to flag medical risks and trigger
